searchBasis.directorInstruction: Search the current catalog, combat action rules, equipment item procedures and accepted Conjure Rope review for an authorized upward-restraint rule. Identify exact source path, hash, pointer and acceptance authority if one qualifies; otherwise record NO_QUALIFYING_CHANGED_SOURCE.

sources.selector: /spells entries where id is reverse-gravity-field and conjure-rope
findings: Reverse Gravity Field has status blocked-pending-operational-review and no operational rule.
Conjure Rope defines a 300 lb total static-load ceiling only when secured to real support; rope commands cannot haul/forcibly move a load, and drawing slack cannot lift or drag for free.
No upward-load/restraint test or stop/stretch/failure/release rule; no rated anchor or attachment assembly.
The combat/action document keeps equipment, cargo and object durability dependencies open and supplies no upward-restraint or dynamic tether rule.
Printed traps/restraints and ordinary climbing/tool procedures do not supply a rated upward-restraint rule, dynamic-load test, or attachment/anchor rating and permission.

sources.acceptanceAuthority: The review marks Conjure Rope approved and states its 300 lb static support ceiling, actual external anchor/support requirement, and that slack-taking cannot lift or drag loads for free.
findings: Accepted rope review does not define an upward force/restraint test or stop/stretch/failure/release behavior, and does not assign an anchor rating.

priorDirectorRuling.relevantFinding: The bound sources do not determine how Reverse Gravity loads a secured tether; selecting new upward strength or automatic stop/break behavior would supply the interaction rather than demonstrate an existing rope rule.

requiredActualEvidence: An authorized upward-restraint rule specifying applicable load/test, slack take-up, and when the rope/attachment/anchor stops, stretches, fails or releases.
An identified lawful anchor/support and attachment assembly with ratings, custody/permission, method, tether path/length/slack, and recipient/gear/applicable-rope mass.
Qualified caster acquisition/preparation, components, Action, actual RP/class bookkeeping, interruption result, rope creation and exact 600-second deadline.
One-time integrated settlement preserving cargo/custody and resolving movement, support and any fall without refunds or duplicated events.

disposition.w2: Open; no qualifying changed source found in the bounded source set.
